title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Safety Recall Campaigns, Remedies and Owner Reimbursement
content:
# Safety Recall Campaigns, Remedies and Owner Reimbursement

## Statement of policy

1. **Campaign scope.** A safety recall campaign of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage applies to the vehicles the manufacturer lists by VIN, and its owner notification date is recorded with it. Each campaign is recorded once per vehicle, by campaign number, with the date recorded and the owner notification date.
2. **Remedy at no charge.** Where the coverage's recall-remedy-free-of-charge setting is Yes, the remedy is performed at no charge to the owner, provided the vehicle's first retail sale was no more than the coverage type's vehicle age limit, in years, before the notification date; the remedy is owed to whoever owns the vehicle, whatever the title brand.
3. **Owner reimbursement.** An owner who paid for a repair of the recalled defect before the notification date is reimbursed the amount paid for that repair, recorded as an owner reimbursement.
4. **Reimbursement claim period.** An owner reimbursement is paid only when it is claimed within the owner reimbursement claim period of calendar days after the notification date. Calendar days are added to the notification date (day 0); a claim on the last day is in time.
5. **Do-not-drive campaigns.** Where the coverage's alternate-transportation setting is Yes and the manufacturer has designated the campaign do-not-drive with remedy parts not yet available, alternate transportation is provided until the remedy is performed.
6. **Open recall.** An open recall is one with no recall remedy claim for its campaign: a campaign recorded against the vehicle for which no paid recall remedy entry with the same campaign number exists, as of the handling date.

## The reimbursement period read as a time test

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the owner notification date recorded with the campaign (day 0) |
| Record relied on | the notification date on the vehicle's recall entries for that campaign number |
| Counting | calendar days added to the notification date |
| Test | the claim date is not after the last day of the period |
| Last day | in time |

**Abstract boundary cases**, for a claim period of N calendar days:

- Claimed on day N after the notification date: in time, and the reimbursement is paid.
- Claimed on day N plus 1: not paid.
- Claimed on the notification date itself (day 0): in time.

## Hypothetical cases

- An owner paid an independent shop to repair a part, and the manufacturer's notification for a recall of that defect is dated later. The owner is reimbursed the amount paid for that repair, provided the claim is made within the claim period.
- A vehicle has two campaigns recorded against it and a paid recall remedy for one of them. The other campaign is an open recall.
- A vehicle now carries a branded title. The recall remedy is still owed to whoever owns the vehicle.
